method: Read-only source audit of the ordered migration chain, actual route bodies, imported feature bodies, client adapters, permissions and readback. No application, SQL or device tests executed. Report assertions below are implementation acceptance criteria, not test results.

ownership.money: Money owns capture/refund/payout lifecycle, arithmetic and financial remediation approval. This report identifies exact booking-facing operands and dispatch mismatches; it does not treat paid labels, a browser return, demo screenshots or payment holds as capture evidence.
ownership.identityAndSharedUI: Coordinator owns identity, native/shared primitives and repository documentation. O25 owns the provider dashboard; O32 owns financial projections. Their concrete service-contract dependencies are identified in the tasks.
ownership.migrationFiles: UNASSIGNED_SV_service_lifecycle.sql, UNASSIGNED_SV_service_read_models.sql and UNASSIGNED_SV_service_layout_flags.sql are explicit UNASSIGNED coordinator claim tokens, not runnable migrations or numeric reservations. Coordinator allocates final numeric filenames/order and serializes shared function edits. Historical source migration names remain exact and must not be rewritten.

visualEvidence.provenance: Coordinator supplied hosted run 44696642603, head 229995fe3194de39684f12ef348d3e37930ae5f2, completed/failure, and verified that its application code matches this audit SHA; only docs/14 differs. Provenance was not independently re-queried by this audit.
visualEvidence.interpretation: Eleven supplied PNGs and contact-05.jpg were inspected. Names are not state, route, runtime-feature or test-pass evidence. No personal account details are reproduced. The reported three Home assertion failures are not evidence of a service implementation failure.

A Completed pill and completion hero precede a review form; the submit control is disabled before a rating is selected.
Only a Booking loading skeleton and a package-booked toast are visible. This does not show the fixed booking form or prove payment/state success.
The plan says Active while provider response says Pending. No upcoming visits are shown; Pause plan and Cancel plan controls are visible.
Schedule mode, date and time-window choices, and a sticky pay/booking footer are visible. No assertion about backend availability or payment is made.

The proposal screen shows a payment-hold notice, service total, separate total-today text, revisions and included work. The sticky accept control displays the full service total rather than the smaller total-today value.
Despite the filename, the image shows a request-detail screen, a waiting-for-proposals empty state and Cancel request. It is not evidence that the compose form was inspected visually.
The quote editor displays rate-card choices, a line editor and a sticky send/summary footer. Settlement text explicitly says it appears after sending.
Closed/no-work hero and booking details. No payable quote or Pay footer is visible in this image.
Continuation shows payments and Help, not a pending quote/Pay footer. No raw status is inferred.

roleStateCases: Customer creation; SQL checks package/service/category/bookability, quantity, owned address and provider conflicts.
Current slot is Date.now()+2h captured on mount, not a user-selected schedule.
New fixed bookings must not be offered when fixed archetype is off; existing bookings remain readable elsewhere.

placement.testCase: SV-FIXED-UI-03: changing saved address updates visible summary and payload; another customer's address remains rejected by create_fixed_booking.

Confirmed proposal start is different from accepted session start and en_route home arrival.
Submitted delivery requires paid milestones before accept, not an end OTP.
Existing cancellation/payment/refund/settlement paths remain independent of Oorva or acquisition feature switches.

placement.current: Hero at top; generic status pill and family-aware hero copy coexist with status-only reusable labels.

placement.current: Generic editor/approval used across families; a pending quote can also render a Pay footer independently of ended booking status.

placement.testCase: SV-REVIEW-UI-02: eligible closed customer can submit once; unpaid, provider, other customer and already-reviewed cases do not advertise submission.

placement.testCase: SV-PRIVACY-RETAIN-01: requested provider/staff sees area only; accepted authorized projection receives address; unrelated viewer is denied.

placement.testCase: SV-PAYMENT-READ-01: partial/pending/failed refunds retain their actual status labels; a refresh failure is visible without erasing old history or asserting capture success.

screens.purpose: Review a fixed proposal's scope, schedule and delivery terms, then customer acceptance or authorized business readback.

The same proposal can have expired historical bookings and a newer booking after hold expiry; bookings[0] is not canonical.
Questions may be sent only while request is open or closed.

states.customer: Start code/read/cancel where policy permits; no-show only after configured grace.
states.provider: Home Start trip; session start code only in +/-15-minute window; eligible provider cancellation.

states.provider: Proposal start code within allowed start date/window with required due milestones paid.
states.admin: Read confirmed proposal and instantiated obligations.

states.actual: Home travel state; registry also permits session travel, although session start RPC accepts accepted only.
states.customer: Start code, policy cancellation and eligible no-show.
states.provider: Home arrive with start OTP; fixed/BYO enters work, inspect enters inspection.
states.admin: Read travel state without assuming work started.

states.customer: Wait for quote or policy cancellation.
states.provider: Send initial itemized quote; eligible provider cancellation.

states.actual: Initial inspect quote awaiting customer. A revision can leave this same booking status unchanged.
states.provider: Revise quote; cannot claim customer approval.
states.admin: Read sent quote/version and booking state separately.

states.actual: Initial inspect quote approved_pending_payment; work not started.
states.customer: Pay due balance or eligible cancellation.
states.admin: Read obligation/quote state separately from capture.

states.actual: Work/session in progress. Inspect/fixed may also have sent or approved_pending_payment change order while booking status stays unchanged.
states.customer: Review permitted change order, pay actual due obligations, or dispute/cancel only per family rules.
states.provider: Inspect full-scope change order, fixed additive change order, session completion request, or proposal begin delivery/no-delivery completion as applicable.
states.admin: Read composite scope/payment state; no generic customer action.

states.actual: Proposal delivery in preparation or revision_requested. Not a payment status.
states.customer: Read terms; deadline+48-hour provider-fault cancellation or delivery dispute when eligible.
states.provider: Submit 1..20 HTTPS links as provider owner; revised delivery retains revision count/note.
states.admin: Read delivery state and dispute context.

states.actual: Home/session completion confirmation, proposal no-delivery completion, or submitted delivery awaiting customer review. These are not the same action.
states.customer: Correct family confirmation; submitted delivery requires all milestones paid then accept_delivery; optional revision if allowed.
states.provider: Home/session/no-delivery completion OTP; submitted proposal waits for review/payment, not generic OTP completion.
states.admin: Read completion/review state; disputed resolution remains separate.

states.actual: Work completion/charged late session cancellation can produce this; payout/dispute resolution may still be pending.
states.customer: Eligible unique review, receipt/read and dispute under current server policy.
states.provider: Read settlement; do not universally promise release in 24 hours for accepted proposal delivery.
states.admin: Read and resolve actual money lifecycle using admin RPCs.

states.actual: Completion's payout transfer finished through complete_transfer; not identical to cancellation or no-work.
states.customer: Eligible review and configured post-close dispute window; receipt/read.
states.admin: Admin projection of same closed PK; dispute resolution only if current state permits.

states.actual: Inspect quote rejected or stale quote/payment timeout; inspection-only outcome.
states.customer: Read inspection/payment/refund outcome; not review-eligible under submit_review.

states.actual: Assigned provider declined a requested booking and refund was requested through existing internals.
states.customer: Read refund rows; do not infer completed refund from booking status.

states.provider: No new work control; released occurrence/history remains readable.
states.admin: Read expiry reason and actual financial outcome.

states.actual: Booking-level full-refund dispute outcome; actual refund rows can still be processing.
states.customer: Read actual refund history; no review/new lifecycle actions.

Latest record_payment_paid handles inspect/fixed/proposal and record_session_payment_paid handles sessions. Funding confirmation changes inspect/fixed/session to requested, proposal to confirmed; accepted plan occurrences can auto-advance requested->accepted.

The client calls time-based start/complete/cancel functions through explicit dispatch. Generic quote and completion RPCs lack equivalent family guard coverage; findings SV-F02 and SV-F21 specify narrow repairs.
Current completed is Past in activity but is not in terminalStatuses; closed is still disputable within configured rules. No universal terminal/end action set should replace these actual predicates.

transitions: B01 | Customer | absent -> pending_payment | create_booking (inspect), create_fixed_booking (fixed), create_session_booking (paid session), accept_proposal (proposal hold). Server-owned price/address/bookability/window; snapshots and initial event created. Pack allocation may instead create requested.

B02 | System payment recorder | pending_payment -> requested for inspect/fixed/session; proposal -> confirmed. Fixed/session plan-mode accepted recurring occurrence additionally requested -> accepted. Only existing recorder acceptance checks decide whether payment is owed; UI return is not evidence.

B03 | Provider OWNER | requested -> accepted via accept_booking: matching provider_id, status requested, not suspended; stamps accepted_at. Current RPC has no own 15-minute deadline predicate, unlike the UI countdown.
B04 | Provider OWNER | requested -> declined via decline_booking: owner/status check, existing refund path, cancelled_reason; readback removes request controls.
B05 | System | nonrecurring requested with updated_at older than 15 minutes -> expired via expire_stale_requests. Recurring requested rows are deliberately excluded.
B06 | Provider OWNER | accepted -> en_route via start_trip; time-based client deliberately no-ops this RPC and should instead open its start workflow.
B07 | Provider OWNER | en_route -> inspecting for inspect, or in_progress for fixed/BYO via arrive with start OTP; fixed overdue-due payment guard and 5-attempt lockout.
B08 | Provider OWNER | accepted time_based -> in_progress via start_session_booking: scheduled_at within +/-15 minutes, no upcoming/due obligations, correct OTP. Separate from proposal start.

B09 | Provider OWNER | confirmed proposal -> in_progress via start_proposal_booking: same scheduled UTC date OR +/-30 minutes, no due non-delivery/completion milestone, correct OTP. This is the actual SQL predicate, not an assumed appointment-wide policy.

B10 | Provider OWNER/MANAGER | inspecting -> quote_sent via send_quote. On quote_sent or in_progress, new quote updates quote rows and logs an event without a booking status change. Full revised inspect scope, not an add-on delta.
B11 | Customer | quote_sent -> awaiting_payment if approve_quote has positive due; -> in_progress if zero due. Initial rejection -> closed_no_work via reject_quote.

B12 | Customer/System | in_progress change order: sent -> approved_pending_payment -> approved or direct approved; booking remains in_progress. Rejection preserves existing approved scope. Fixed-specific approval creates addon schedule; generic approval does not.

B13 | Provider OWNER | in_progress -> completion_requested via request_session_completion for sessions, request_completion for inspect/fixed/proposal-no-delivery. Proposal on_completion obligations become due; inspect/fixed pending quotes must first be resolved.

B14 | Provider OWNER | proposal in_progress/pending delivery -> delivery_pending via begin_delivery. Then pending|revision_requested -> submitted and booking -> completion_requested via submit_delivery; on_delivery obligations become due and customer notified.

B15 | Customer | submitted delivery/completion_requested -> delivery_pending/revision_requested via request_revision, only creator_revisions enabled, remaining count and note length 5..1000. Completion timer cleared; used count incremented; provider notified.

B16 | Customer | submitted delivery/completion_requested -> completed with delivery_status accepted via accept_delivery, only all schedule rows paid. Private _finalize_completion applies existing accepted-delivery dispute window. Generic confirm_completion currently bypasses the delivery-status update; SV-F21 repairs entry points, not formulas.

B17 | Customer or Provider OWNER | completion_requested -> completed via correct confirm/OTP completion RPC. Proposal no-delivery requires all milestones paid. Session uses _finalize_session_completion and its actual backing payment, not a quote finalizer.

B18 | System | completion_requested -> completed via auto_confirm_completions: default 24h non-delivery, category deliverable_acceptance_hours (default 72) for proposal submitted/accepted; revisions excluded and proposal all-paid guard retained.

B19 | Customer | eligible states -> cancelled via cancel_booking / cancel_session_booking; generic policy supports pending/requested/accepted/confirmed/en_route/inspecting/quote_sent/awaiting_payment/in_progress/completion_requested. Proposal submitted/accepted delivery is explicitly excluded by latest private cancellation guard; delivery_pending allowed only promised deadline+48h provider fault.

B20 | Provider OWNER | requested/accepted/confirmed/en_route/inspecting/quote_sent/awaiting_payment -> cancelled via provider_cancel_booking, reason provider_cancellation|provider_no_show. This does not grant managers generic provider cancellation.

B21 | Customer/session policy | pending/requested/accepted time_based cancellation: existing 12h policy returns/refunds or completes/consumes the paid session; do not assume cancellation always yields cancelled. Distinct from provider-fault policy.

B22 | Customer | in_progress/delivery_pending/completion_requested/completed or configured in-window closed -> disputed via dispute_booking. Requires reason; money freeze/notification semantics remain with money owner.

B23 | Opposing Customer or Provider OWNER | accepted/en_route home/fixed/session -> disputed via report_no_show: home_no_show_reporting, correct absent party, scheduled_at plus configured grace passed. Creates support case and freezes safety paths.

B24 | Admin | disputed -> refunded for full_refund, or completed/finalization for partial_refund/denied via resolve_dispute. No other actor may resolve; admin monetary formulas are outside this stream.
B25 | System | completed -> closed only when pending payout's transfers finish in complete_transfer. Refunded/cancelled/closed_no_work are not synonyms.

B26 | System | proposal pending_payment hold past expiry -> expired; proposal accepted resets to sent if still valid and request closed resets open if still unexpired. This permits multiple historical booking rows.

B27 | System | unpaid recurring pending_payment -> expired according to actual due/grace/visit-minus-30m cutoff; waives open obligations, refunds safely, logs a cancelled change and releases reservation. Acquisition flags do not stop cleanup.
B28 | System | stalled inspect quote_sent/awaiting_payment older than configured 24..168h timeout (default48) -> closed_no_work; existing paid inspection settlement retained.
